scope: operational provenance, terms, attribution, and removal review for the four bounded web sources; not legal advice or a final ownership determination

ultrafineweb_en_v1_4.upstream: English data is based on FineWeb/Common Crawl
ultrafineweb_en_v1_4.material_observation: the pinned card explicitly instructs users to inspect each upstream dataset license; the project license alone is not treated as clearance of underlying pages
ultrafineweb_en_v1_4.human_decision_required: accept the FineWeb ODC-By and Common Crawl chain for the intended training and release scope, or reject Ultra-FineWeb

fineweb_edu.material_observation: ODC-By grants database rights with attribution but states that it does not govern individual contents
fineweb_edu.human_decision_required: accept the database attribution plan, Common Crawl terms, and residual underlying-content risk, or reject FineWeb-Edu

dclm_baseline.upstream: DCLM Pool derived from Common Crawl
dclm_baseline.material_observation: the pinned card repeatedly describes research-only intended use and says it is not intended for production-ready models despite its CC-BY metadata
dclm_baseline.human_decision_required: resolve the card's research-only language against the intended model/release scope and accept the Common Crawl chain, or reject DCLM

fineweb_base.material_observation: the card supplies source URLs and a PII removal channel and records prior domain removal in response to a cease-and-desist notice
fineweb_base.human_decision_required: accept the database attribution plan, Common Crawl terms, and residual underlying-content risk, or reject FineWeb

common_crawl_terms_observations: use of Crawled Content signifies binding acceptance, including later modifications while use continues
crawled pages may have separate owner terms and Common Crawl does not warrant lawfulness or non-infringement
users must respect third-party copyright, privacy, and other rights
the indemnification clause expressly names developing, training, or deploying AI systems and generated content
the terms include releases, liability limits, California law, individual arbitration, and a class-action waiver
proposed_attribution_and_removal_control: retain each record's source dataset, immutable dataset revision, released-content hash, original URL/host where supplied, and successor lineage
publish dataset-level credits and required ODC-By or CC-BY notices for every source actually used
preserve the Ultra-FineWeb, FineWeb/FineWeb-Edu, DCLM, and Common Crawl citations and links
name a human-controlled contact for rights, privacy, and removal requests before production acquisition
maintain a hash/URL/domain deny ledger that applies before future packing and can rebuild affected shards and attribution manifests
record upstream takedowns and term changes; do not silently mutate already frozen experiment data
decide separately whether any dataset or extracted text may be redistributed; model-weight release does not imply corpus redistribution
non_conclusions: dataset-level Apache-2.0, ODC-By, or CC-BY metadata clears copyright or other rights in every crawled page
public accessibility authorizes training, commercial use, redistribution, or every intended model release
technical PII, security, deduplication, and contamination filters resolve source rights
this packet constitutes acceptance of any license or terms

acceptance_record_required.authority: named human with authority for the operating organization and intended use
must_record: organization and intended research, publication, model-weight release, and any commercial scope
accepted evidence hashes and Common Crawl terms date
redistribution decision for source data and derived packed shards
removal contact, deny-ledger owner, response procedure, and rebuild policy
date, name, and signature or equivalent auditable approval
